chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: Marco, Vadim: Are you actually here and Meetecho just shows you as Zulip-Only?

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Looking at the list, clearly 2 is a no-brainer (just a style issue, so let's follow the majority), and 6 is a matter of work distribution between core and cbor -- core will happily pick this up again, I think.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I'd add to list 2 items: non-optional commas for maps and moving EI to front app-prefix, but I not yet figured out ABNF for former, and not sure for latter as it is not removal

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: well, I don't know if thing like 200.0_millisec will require IANA registry, I just want to support thing like such in my implementation

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
Carsten Bormann
chat.text: The first never was

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: i'm pretty sure I found some examples in the wild like this.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: just treat ... as unimplemented reserved word, for error message?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: yes

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I'll not implement cri'' (in non-constrained world), so make it non-mandatory, otherwise I have no opinion

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: as I understand, it may be needed for like h'01 /* code for SHA256/512 */ AB...'

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: isn't having same /**/ inside simpler for single-pass parsers?

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: you still have to support / / quotes for backwards compatibility

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: / / comments

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Artificial Limitations: Don't do that.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: Mikolai raised similar point and I responded that implementation can issue warning "too much backticks, check security"

chat.author: Martine Lenders
chat.text: +1 at what CA just said.

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: we just need to ingest JSON, but otherwise we can be - and should be - better JSON!

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: refoo\bar was the point

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Say again?

chat.text: const X: f32 = 3.;

chat.text: there was just some discussion between VG and RM on 11

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: float<<[sig, exp]>>

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: That doesn't suffice?

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: we can have r'' as a replacement for now-current float''

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Thank you!

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: thanks Mikolai

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Yes.

chat.author: Mikolai Gütschow
chat.text: RM want to talk about 11 again

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: ah, r'' and app-backtick are two different questions

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: pref`foo`  makes it possible to use raw strings to avoid backslash handling.

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: he's saying you can always do pref<<foo>>

chat.author: Martine Lenders
chat.text: Yes, but what RM is saying, that can also be expressed as pref<<foo>>

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/cbor/YUue9jSD8XMNWtRogTPf9X-JxsI/

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: an r'' is a replacement for now-current float'' which is just bytes - e.g. use "float" name for something better

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Obviously, a single pair of backquotes is better than  <<`  and  `>> .

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: I don't think that is obvious in the slightest

chat.author: Joe Hildebrand
chat.text: it's not obvious, but I agree with you carsten

chat.author: Rohan Mahy
chat.text: I will point out the readability problem of have extensions that use the same character for starting and ending delimiters

chat.author: Carsten Bormann
chat.text: Don't do that then
